title: Control Remediation Register

rlsNoPolicy.interpretation: For the current advisor-scoped set, anon/authenticated cannot effectively SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE. RLS-with-no-policy remains an access-model classification task, not a reason to add permissive policies.
rlsNoPolicy.reasonNotClosed: Owner/table-class and intended-caller classifications plus future grant-regression evidence are still required.

securityDefiner.interpretation: All current advisor-scoped privileged RPCs are authenticated-only, reference auth.uid(), and have a controlled empty search_path. Static signals materially reduce accidental-public-RPC concern but do not prove function-level cross-user authorization correctness.
securityDefiner.reasonNotClosed: All 47 still require class/function authorization review; six lack an obvious static RAISE/RETURN NULL rejection signal.

leakedPasswordProtection.currentSupabaseDocsRequirement: Leaked password protection is available on the Pro Plan and above.
leakedPasswordProtection.requiredDecision: Approve current cost + governed Auth change, or explicitly document bounded risk treatment/compensating controls. P35 does neither automatically.

authRlsInitplan.interpretation: RLS expression shape requires policy-by-policy performance review; P35 does not rewrite policies solely to clear a performance advisor warning.

deficiencies.action: Choose governed plan/Auth remediation or explicit bounded risk treatment for leaked-password protection.

Onboard semester-os into ownership/lifecycle and P29 dependency graph, then reconcile P31 coverage to 100%.
Pass the P35 start gate, freeze the scoped control/evidence baseline, then begin—not backfill—the operating-effectiveness period.
